translations.text: The vision of Obadiah. Thus says the Lord to Edom: I heard a report from the Lord, and he sent a siege against the nations: “Rise, and let us rise against her for war!”
Look, I have made you small among the nations, and you are greatly despised.
The pride of your heart raised you up to dwell in the clefts of rocks, to set your dwelling high, and to say in your heart, “Who will bring me down to the earth?”
Even if you rise high like an eagle, and even if you set your nest among the stars, I will bring you down from there, says the Lord.
If thieves or robbers by night had come to you, where would you hide? Would they not steal enough for themselves? And if grape gatherers had come to you, would they not leave even one cluster?
How Esau has been searched, and his hidden things seized!
All the men of your covenant sent you away to the borders. They turned against you; the men who were at peace with you prevailed against you. They bewildered you, and there was no wisdom in him.
On that day, says the Lord, I will destroy wisdom from the land of Edom and understanding from the mountain of Esau.
And your warriors from Teman will tremble, so that every man may be removed from the mountain of Esau.
Because of the murder and wickedness against your brother Jacob, shame will cover you, and you will be wiped out forever.
From the day when you stood against him, on the day when foreigners took his forces captive and strangers entered his gates and cast lots over Jerusalem, you too were like one of them.
Do not look upon your brother’s devastation on the day of foreigners. Do not trample the sons of Judah in the days of their destruction, and do not speak boastfully on the day of distress.

And do not enter the gates of the peoples on the day of their suffering. Do not look upon their assemblies on the day of their annihilation, and do not attack their forces on the day of their destruction.
And do not seize their mountain passes to destroy those among them who have survived, and do not besiege their fugitives on the day of their distress.
For the day of the Lord is near against all the nations. As you have done, so it will be done to you, and your recompense will return upon your head.
For just as you drank on my holy mountain, all the nations will drink wine. They will drink and go down, and they will be as though they had never existed.
But on Mount Zion there will be deliverance, and there will be holiness, and the house of Jacob will take possession of those who took possession of them.

The house of Jacob will be fire, and the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau reeds. They will set it ablaze and consume it, and no fire-bearer will remain in the house of Esau, for the Lord has spoken.

The people of the Negeb will possess the mountain of Esau, and the people of the Shephelah will possess the Philistines. They will possess the mountain of Ephraim and the plain of Samaria, and Benjamin and the people of Gilead.

And this shall be the beginning of the exile for the children of Israel: the land of the Canaanites as far as Zarephath, and the exile of Jerusalem as far as Ephrathah; and they shall inherit the cities of the Negeb.
And survivors will come up from Mount Zion to take vengeance on the mountain of Esau, and the kingdom will belong to the Lord.
